query: Has anyone housed powered, operating laboratory or production instruments (not passive inventory such as samples, reagents, tools or spare parts) inside the trays or carriers of a vertical lift module (VLM), vertical carousel, paternoster or other automated storage and retrieval system, so that the storage machine brings the instrument to a fixed access opening where a person or robot loads it, and the instrument keeps running (with power, data, gas or exhaust) while its tray is stored? Include laboratory automation, biobanks, pharmacies, incubator hotels, burn-in and test racks in electronics manufacturing, server or battery-cycling racks, and patents.
